Tessera health and product use.name: Tessera health and product use
Tessera health and product use.description: Anonymous macOS usage. Local-drive p99 is a 120 second goal, never a timeout. Read sample counts, failures, partial coverage, scope, version and cache state together. Cloud and remote results are separate. Automated tests and benchmarks are excluded. No file data or person profiles.

Local scan p99, samples and coverage.name: Local scan p99, samples and coverage

source.query: SELECT properties.source_class AS source, properties.scope AS scope, properties.coverage AS coverage, properties.cache_state AS cache_state, properties.$app_version AS app_version, count() AS samples, quantile(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms))/1000 AS median_seconds, quantile(0.99)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms))/1000 AS p99_seconds, max(toFloat(properties.duration_ms))/1000 AS maximum_seconds, countIf(toFloat(properties.duration_ms) > 120000) AS over_goal FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'tessera scan completed' AND properties.source_class IN ('local_internal','local_external','local_unknown') GROUP BY source,scope,coverage,cache_state,app_version

Local scan p99, samples and coverage.description: Successful completions only. A partial scan is separate from a complete scan. Use the outcomes panel for failures and cancellations. Small production samples do not establish population p99.

source.query: SELECT properties.source_class AS source, properties.coverage AS coverage, count() AS samples, quantile(0.99)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms))/1000 AS p99_seconds, max(toFloat(properties.duration_ms))/1000 AS maximum_seconds FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'tessera scan completed' AND properties.source_class IN ('cloud','remote','unknown') GROUP BY source,coverage

Scan outcomes including failure and canc.name: Scan outcomes including failure and cancellation

source.query: SELECT event, properties.source_class AS source, properties.outcome AS outcome, properties.coverage AS coverage, count() AS events FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ('tessera scan started','tessera scan completed','tessera scan cancelled','tessera scan failed') GROUP BY event,source,outcome,coverage

Scan outcomes including failure and canc.description: Starts and terminal events are counts, not a paired per-scan conversion. App exits may leave starts without a terminal event.

Cleanup outcomes and held items.name: Cleanup outcomes and held items

source.query: SELECT properties.method AS method, properties.outcome AS outcome, count() AS batches, sum(toFloat(properties.moved)) AS moved, sum(toFloat(properties.held)) AS held, sum(toFloat(properties.failed)) AS failed FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event = 'tessera cleanup completed' GROUP BY method,outcome

Cleanup outcomes and held items.description: Cleanup safety rules never change with a remote flag.

Screen and tool use.name: Screen and tool use

source.query: SELECT event, coalesce(properties.$screen_name,properties.tool) AS screen_or_tool, count() AS events, uniq(distinct_id) AS anonymous_installs FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ('$screen','tessera tool opened','tessera tool completed') GROUP BY event,screen_or_tool ORDER BY events DESC

Screen and tool use.description: Fixed names only. No search terms or file data.

Native crashes and update outcomes.name: Native crashes and update outcomes

source.query: SELECT event, properties.outcome AS outcome, count() AS events FROM events WHERE properties.application = 'Tessera' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND event IN ('$exception','tessera update completed') GROUP BY event,outcome

Native crashes and update outcomes.description: Crash text and paths are removed on-device. Symbolication uses image UUIDs and instruction addresses.

Anonymous weekly return use.name: Anonymous weekly return use

source.query: WITH first_use AS (SELECT distinct_id, min(toDate(timestamp)) AS first_day FROM events WHERE properties.application='Tessera' AND event='tessera app opened' GROUP BY distinct_id) SELECT toStartOfWeek(first_day) AS cohort_week, uniq(f.distinct_id) AS installs, uniqIf(f.distinct_id,dateDiff('day',first_day,toDate(e.timestamp)) BETWEEN 7 AND 13) AS returned_days_7_to_13 FROM first_use f JOIN events e ON f.distinct_id=e.distinct_id WHERE e.event='tessera app opened' AND e.properties.application='Tessera' AND first_day >= today()-30 AND first_day <= today()-13 GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week

Anonymous weekly return use.description: Random install IDs only, no accounts. Mature cohorts only. Reinstalling or clearing app storage changes the ID.

Explore to reviewed cleanup funnel.name: Explore to reviewed cleanup funnel
Explore to reviewed cleanup funnel.description: Ordered seven-day flow per anonymous install. This is product use, not a measure of scan correctness.

Tessera native satisfaction.name: Tessera native satisfaction
Tessera native satisfaction.description: Optional fixed 1–5 rating in macOS Settings. No text response or automatic popup.

questions.question: How easy is Tessera to use?

Tessera compact child browser.name: Tessera compact child browser
Tessera compact child browser.description: Presentation only: four versus eight visible rows. Full child list remains scrollable. No scan or cleanup policy changes. Draft until native UI qualification.
